# Ein Sof Captions — Phase Two: Gevurah Boundaries

The Awtsmoos gives infinite light through finite vessels that do not fight;
Awtsmoos.com must preserve the renderer while making every control feel light.

## Concrete source defects

1. One 893-line HTML file owns markup, styling, rendering algorithms, persistence, worker bootstrap, download logic, UI binding, and business state.
2. Several worker helpers are one-line compressed functions, making maintenance and verification unsafe.
3. Controls are permanently 500px wide and the preview permanently 540×960 before the lone broad breakpoint.
4. The mobile fallback simply stacks a 95vw control wall above a 95vw×1.7777 preview, so the first meaningful preview can require enormous scrolling.
5. Advanced settings are always visible; users must traverse every particle/network/effect setting before the primary action.
6. Randomization uses emoji spans without button semantics or accessible pressed state.
7. Continuous pulse and flicker animations compete with the creative preview.
8. No reduced-motion policy exists.
9. Status uses `display` mutation rather than a stable accessible state region.
10. Generate has no clear batch count/progress fraction outside textual worker messages.
11. The worker is created from an inline script blob, preventing normal module inspection, caching, and composition.
12. Storage code serializes every element with an id, including unrelated display elements, instead of a defined control set.

## Architectural boundaries

### Markup
- `index.html` — shell only, <=120 lines.

### CSS
- `css/tokens.css` — palette, dimensions, semantic layers.
- `css/base.css` — reset, typography, focus, accessibility utilities.
- `css/shell.css` — app grid, studio rail, preview stage.
- `css/panels.css` — native retractable details sections.
- `css/controls.css` — inputs, sliders, randomize buttons, action bar.
- `css/preview.css` — canvas frame, status overlay.
- `css/responsive.css` — mobile drawer and narrow layouts.
- `css/motion.css` — short transitions and reduced-motion overrides.

### Main-thread JS
- `js/KliEinSofDom.js` — required DOM vessels.
- `js/OhrControlManifest.js` — explicit setting ids/types/default semantics.
- `js/ChesedSettingsStore.js` — IndexedDB persistence using existing DB contract.
- `js/GevurahStudioDrawer.js` — desktop collapse + mobile drawer state.
- `js/TiferesRandomization.js` — pressed buttons + min/max reveal/state.
- `js/NetzachSettingsCollector.js` — renderer payload assembly.
- `js/HodDownloadManager.js` — directory picker/download fallback.
- `js/YesodRenderCoordinator.js` — module Worker lifecycle and progress.
- `js/MalchusPreview.js` — canvas display and initial state.
- `js/app.js` — composition root only.

### Worker modules
- `worker/ein-sof-worker.js` — receives job, loops captions, emits messages.
- `worker/BorehOlam.js` — orchestration.
- `worker/OlamBackground.js` — starfield/nebula/shooting-star background.
- `worker/YetzirahParticles.js` — particle universe + glyph render.
- `worker/KavNetwork.js` — web/arcs/synapse connections.
- `worker/TiferesText.js` — text fit, box blur, border, corner B\"H.
- `worker/HodPost.js` — bloom and post-processing.
- `worker/OhrPalette.js` — palette and color conversion.
- `worker/ChesedRandom.js` — random numbers/colors/settings resolution.

## Preserve / improve line

Preserve renderer visuals and defaults where practical. Simplify the surrounding UI radically. Do not silently remove an advanced parameter just because it is hidden behind a disclosure. Do not change persistence keys. Do not make directory access mandatory. Do not move expensive pixel processing onto the main thread.

## Verification graph

- Every source file <=120 lines.
- Every JS module parses.
- Worker module dependency graph resolves.
- All manifest controls exist in DOM.
- Desktop 1440×900: preview dominates, no page horizontal overflow, rail retracts.
- Mobile 390×844 and 320×568: preview visible before enormous scrolling; studio drawer opens/closes and body does not overflow horizontally.
- All advanced panels are native keyboard-accessible disclosures.
- Randomize controls expose `aria-pressed` and min/max only when active.
- Existing IndexedDB settings load without exceptions.
- Worker can render a low-complexity synthetic job and send result/complete.
- Canvas result appears and a download path is invoked only by explicit generation.
